record.paper_title: String Theory on ADS3: Some Open Questions
record.context_brief: Euclidean H3+ partition function and modular invariance
record.original_question: Why, if at all, is the path-integral partition function obtained for Euclidean three-dimensional anti-de Sitter space H3+ = SL(2,C)/SU(2) satisfactory when it is not modular invariant, and what does that imply for the analogous SU(1,1) or AdS3 string-theory partition function?

evidence.quote: the result (2.10) was obtained in [6] as the partition function of Euclidean three-dimensional anti-de Sitter space, H3+ ≡ SL(2,C)/SU(2), by using a rigorous path-integral approach.
It is not clear why such a non-modular-invariant partition function would be satisfactory in the case of H3+.
modular invariance should be demanded for any finite value of v.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $H_3^+ = SL(2,\mathbb{C})/SU(2)$ denote Euclidean three-dimensional anti-de Sitter space, viewed as a target space for a WZW-type string sigma model at level $k$. Computing the worldsheet torus partition function on $H_3^+$ via a rigorous path-integral approach (with modular parameter $\tau$ of the worldsheet torus and a twist/holonomy parameter $v$) yields a one-loop expression that is not invariant under the modular group $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$ acting on $\tau$.

(a) Provide a conceptual justification, or show that no such justification exists, for accepting this path-integral partition function on $H_3^+$ as a satisfactory definition of the one-loop free energy even though it fails to be modular invariant for generic finite $v$.

(b) Determine what consequences this has for the analytically continued partition function of string theory on Lorentzian $AdS_3$ (the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ or $SU(1,1)$ WZW model): namely, decide whether a modular-invariant partition function for strings on $AdS_3$ can be constructed that reduces to (or is consistent with) the $H_3^+$ path-integral result, and identify the spectrum (continuous and discrete series representations, including spectral-flow sectors) that must be included to achieve modular invariance for every finite value of $v$.
artifact.category_tag: AdS3 string partition functions and modular invariance
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work by Maldacena, Ooguri and Maldacena–Ooguri–Son (the "Strings in AdS3 and the SL(2,R) WZW model" series, especially Part II, J. Math. Phys. 42 (2001) 2961) explicitly computed the one-loop partition function on Euclidean AdS3/thermal AdS3, demonstrated that the H3+ path-integral result becomes modular invariant once properly interpreted (including the unbounded sum over winding/spectral-flow sectors and the full spectrum of continuous and discrete series), and matched it with the Lorentzian SL(2,R) WZW spectrum. This resolved the modular-invariance puzzle for the AdS3 string partition function. Recent (2025) work continues to refine the one-loop computation but confirms modular invariance.

status_evidence.title: Strings in AdS3 and the SL(2,R) WZW model. II: Euclidean black hole
status_evidence.snippet: Computes the one-loop partition function on Euclidean AdS3/BTZ as a quotient of H3+ and shows the resulting spectrum is modular invariant.
status_evidence.claim: The H3+ partition function admits a modular-invariant interpretation matching the SL(2,R) WZW spectrum.

status_evidence.title: Modular invariance of string theory on AdS3
status_evidence.snippet: Paper establishing modular invariance of the AdS3 string partition function.
status_evidence.claim: Modular invariance of strings on AdS3 has been established.

status_evidence.title: Strings in AdS3: one-loop partition function and near-extremal BTZ thermodynamics, JHEP 05 (2025) 010
status_evidence.snippet: Revisits the one-loop AdS3 string partition function, confirming modular invariance and refining its interpretation.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work confirms and refines the modular-invariant one-loop AdS3 string partition function.
